about: Two people talk about a question one of them put to Friday earlier. Her name is on the line and nothing is asked of her: she stays silent and starts no run.

lines.say: I asked Friday what the plan costs.
Fifty a month, for the whole team.

notes: Not one of the live rig's scenarios: added for the review of #3896. The words after her name open the way a request does ("what the plan costs"), which is what a rule that gives every part after a sole agent's name to that agent would take as her request. The name is talked about (the classifier's `mentioned`), not spoken to.

expect.why: a report of a question is not the question
